openSource.title: Fixed #36892 -- Added LazySerializer for lazy objects in migrations.
description: Engineered a custom LazySerializer to resolve a long-standing regression where lazy-evaluated tuples (e.g., in model choices) caused redundant migration generation.
Implemented advanced deconstruction of django.utils.functional.Promise objects using __reduce__ to correctly identify and serialize wrapped non-string types.

Integrated a conditional logic flow in serializer_factory to distinguish between translatable strings (lazy-i18n) and functional lazy objects, ensuring zero breakage for existing string-based migrations.
Developed a robust regression test suite validating the serialization and reconstruction of lazy-wrapped tuples, lists, and dictionaries within the MigrationWriter.

openSource.title: Fixed #36835 -- Added all public API classes to django.template.__all__.
description: Refactored the django.template namespace to explicitly define its public API using __all__, removing the need for redundant # NOQA linter suppressions.
Resolved a circular import error caused by the reordering of the autoreload module, ensuring proper initialization of the EngineHandler.
Streamlined module imports by removing unnecessary isort:skip tags and improving static analysis support for IDEs and developers.
Demonstrated a deep understanding of Django's internal boot process and dependency management between template engines and system utilities.

openSource.title: Fixed #36894 -- Added TypeError for conflicting arguments in mail APIs.
description: Refactored core email APIs to enforce strict argument validation, preventing silent failures when conflicting parameters were provided.
Implemented explicit TypeError raises across the django.core.mail module to improve developer debugging and API consistency.
Developed exhaustive test suites using unittest.subTest to validate keyword arguments and ensured backward compatibility.
Authored technical documentation for the Django 6.1 release detailing API best practices.
